prompt_en: Photorealistic narrative photograph: a flooded baroque library manuscript rescue centered on one unmistakably adult woman visually informed by the supplied appearance reference. In a three-quarter frame she braces against a marble reading table and pulls an illuminated manuscript from a collapsing carved shelf into a raised archival cradle as ankle-deep water sweeps gilded folios past toppled globes and ladders. Keep her unobscured, recognizable face and the complete readable arrangement of her hair from crown to ends. Neutral window light with floodwater bounce reveals balayage ribbon color placement: irregular freehand lighter ribbons cross the hair surface; the darker roots transition softly into lighter sections, and no hard universal root line separates the colors; lighter color concentrates through varied mid-lengths and ends, while the distributed ribbons become more visible away from the roots; the darker base remains visible between lighter ribbons, and base color threads continuously through the placement; a full-width ombre gradient and regular foil stripes do not substitute. Preserve clear rescue causality, convincingly photorealistic architectural damage, reflected floodwater, fragile paper textures, natural skin texture, and believable hand-to-manuscript contact.
negative_en: body distortion, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background, distorted fingers, plastic-looking skin
